scripts.bootstrap: go mod download && go tool air -v && bun install --cwd=ui --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd=site --frozen-lockfile
scripts.lint: bun --cwd=ui run lint && bun --cwd=site run lint && shellcheck installer/install.sh installer/install_test.sh
scripts.tsc: bun --cwd=ui run tsc && bun --cwd=site run tsc
scripts.test: bun --cwd=ui run test && bun --cwd=site run test && sh installer/install_test.sh
